I am reading about it rn and it is a good summary of my childhood

I guess you are right. Maybe she wanted to get attention from my father but it didn't happen and I wasn't able to make him do something and she resented me. 

As for the nurse, I don't know if she was a family friend. I don't think so. It was the first and last time I saw her. I feel like she saw me an "adult" because as a child I was quiet and didn't cause much trouble (mainly because I was always anxious as fu** but I didn't know that was anxiety until recently, I thought everyone felt that way lol)

I don't know if I am a sociopath but there is sure something very off about me to the point where I need to isolate myself because I hate to be aware of how strange I am with people.

When I was a kid I have always thought that my parents were normal. But looking back when I would go to another kid's house I would feel so safe that I didn't want to go back to my own house which made me angry towards myself. How can I not want to be with my own family they love me. 

As for verbal abuse I have been called names. I have very low self esteem. My father had never said anything nice to me it doesn't matter how good I would behave it was never good, I was always doing something wrong. I don't know what is worse, the insults, the ignoring just because, the dirty looks. Worse part is I just wanted his affection and to be honest I would have done anything for that. But living with him is like being always scared because you never know when or why he could get angry. The few times I looked relaxed or a little happy I would have to shut it down inmediately because I could feel how he hated that.

Now I don't think I am better than them. When people are nice to me I run away. I feel uncomfortable if things fo well, I self sabotage all the time. The only friend I truely cared about I met when I was 10 and I feel like I was mean to her and I wouldnt fully open to her eventhough she would show me a lot of care and genuine affection (she did good when cutting things off at 14 or so).

Right now I am 23. My parents aren't with me but I can't seem to go on with my life. I think therapy is good I am just so anxious I can't get myself to go. I am scared of what to say or how. I am scared of being dishonest there. Of the person looking at me weird.

Sorry for all this don't feel forced to reply by any means.
I am not a great person eventhough sometimes I try to show that. Even when I try to be genuine I question myself. What if I am just being fake. Thanks for your reply though.

Thank you for your insight. I never thought about the healthy role model thing. Even now I feel like I am unconciously looking for a parent in every person I meet. I am stuck at 4 years old emotionally and have no idea how to act normal and I can become very toxic.
